title: What your client sees on an invoice

steps.caption: Invoices
steps.narration: When you send an invoice, your client gets their own page for it. Here is what they see.

steps.caption: A sent invoice
steps.narration: Take this invoice. It has been sent, and it is waiting to be paid.

steps.caption: The client's screen
steps.narration: Now your client's screen. They open the invoice from the link in their email.

steps.caption: Number and amount due
steps.narration: At the top right are the invoice number, the due date, and the amount due.

steps.caption: Who it is for
steps.narration: Then who the invoice is for.

steps.caption: Lines and total
steps.narration: Below that, each line of work, and the invoice total.

steps.caption: Pay this invoice
steps.narration: Under the invoice is Pay this invoice. The money goes straight to your own payment account.

steps.caption: A private page
steps.narration: It is a private page. It opens only after they confirm their email address.

steps.caption: Pay
steps.narration: Your client chooses the pay button.

steps.caption: The secure checkout page
steps.narration: That opens the secure checkout page. In this demo, it is a stand-in page.

steps.caption: Bank account
steps.narration: This client pays from a bank account.

steps.caption: Payment processing
steps.narration: Back on the invoice, it says Payment processing. A bank payment takes a few days to clear.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, you can look at any client's page yourself.

steps.caption: Open an invoice
steps.narration: Click an invoice's number to open its client.

steps.caption: Contractor preview
steps.narration: This is the same page your client sees. Paying is switched off in the preview.

steps.caption: Back
steps.narration: Go back when you are done.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Invoices is in the left menu.

youtube.title: What your client sees when you send an invoice | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See the invoice page your client opens from ConstructHUB CRM: the invoice, the amount due, and Pay this invoice. The walkthrough follows a bank payment and shows how to preview any client's page yourself. Recorded in a demo workspace with a demonstration checkout page in place of the real hosted checkout.
